## Details

<a id="demo_moves"></a>
### [`demo_moves`](../../../../src/input/demo_moves.asm#L6) `$5EA8-$5EE7`

*data*

Demo moves, one byte each. Bits 0-3 go to $8b as joystick bits ($f = no direction). Bits 4-7 give the count of steps. A byte with bits 0-3 = 0 ends the demo. Fire also ends the demo.

- **Read by:** [`run_demo`](../title/demo.md#run_demo)
